title: How Long Does It Take by Boat From Funchal to Cabo Girão?
description: Cabo Girão is about 5 nautical miles (9 to 10 km) west of Funchal by sea: around 15 minutes at a fast cruise, 40 to 60 minutes at a slow pace along the coast.
heroAlt: Drone view of a white motor boat cruising west along Madeira's south coast towards Cabo Girão
